limitations: Sharpe undefined in zero-volatility periods remains blank/ND with its reason.
Slippage is informational and already embedded in execution prices.
Subperiods use preceding equity; no capital reset.
Exposure includes dust per the original ledger definition; exclusive sample endpoint differs from native end-1ns by at most 1ns.
Utilization and margin extrema are daily closes, not intraday maxima.
H3 BASE asset-minute data are explicitly derived aliases.
Portable verifier hashes original Parquets and rechecks persisted arithmetic; it does not independently simulate the engine or reread massive market inputs.
No historical rule timeline completeness, causal significance, out-of-sample validity, Git commit or publication is claimed.
